title: [P2.15d-i-pre] Server-derived stepUpAuthRef for approval.decide_intent: carry the authenticated transport fact on the HumanReviewWitness and burn a one-shot replay digest per approval
description:
FILED per governor-0af24e35's 17:26Z authorization (msg-3625052e): "STEP_UP: FILE IT NOW". Third of the four missing facts at the landed approval.decide_intent seam (task-6646f888, DONE): apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.ts:194-197 refuses `APPROVAL_MISSING_FACT_CODES[1]` = `APPROVAL_INTENT_STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE` @ DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT after task-ba102165 lands riskTier + policy ref. Its doc (:69-70): "The operator witness carries no transport fact, so no session replay digest is derivable."

THE GAP, MEASURED AT HEAD 5834b676: `HumanReviewWitness` (bootstrap/bootstrap-ledger-vocabulary.ts:162) is `{ principalId }` only; it is minted at the composition root when the authenticated principal equals the configured operator (daemon-command-registry.ts:200, daemon-command-edges.ts:55) and never decoded from bytes (bootstrap-services.ts:217). `ApprovalDecisionRecord.stepUpAuthRef` (packages/core/src/policy/approval-contract.ts:59, in the exact roster approval-validation.ts:25) must be a validRef for truthClass HUMAN_APPROVED (approval-validation.ts:63) and null for SYSTEM_POLICY (:68); approval-invalidation.ts:70-83 gates on it. NO production writer derives it: `git grep -n stepUpAuthRef HEAD -- apps ':!*test*' ':!*fixture*'` hits only consumers. The burn primitive exists: `observeReplayMarker` (identity/session-authority-store.ts:358) burns a 64-hex replay digest at expected version 0 (SessionAuthorityReplayObserved); `sessionReplayDigest` (session-authority-protocol.ts) derives one.

DELIVER: (1) the witness gains SERVER-KNOWN transport facts assembled at the composition root only — the authenticated session/credential identity the ingress already resolved (session-authenticator.ts:139: paired principalId IS the session id; the local operator credential has no session and must be named as its own case, refused or given its own fact — decide at planning, never default) and the request identity (commandId/requestDigest); (2) at approval-intent.ts:194 the seam derives stepUpAuthRef = the replay digest over (transport fact, request identity, runId), burns it via observeReplayMarker (a second approval with the same authentication refuses with exact code+layer), and advances the stub to APPROVAL_MISSING_FACT_CODES[3] (BUDGET_REF) — refuse-until-fact-exists; (3) absence of the transport fact still refuses STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE. Never derive from payload bytes.

FAMILY: approval.decide_intent seam (6646f888 DONE; ba102165 WORKING owns riskTier+policy ref at :194 — sequence after it, DoD 1 gates). CONSUMER: the seam itself (production call site at :194) and P2.15d live approval.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK first, in a row comment with `git rev-parse HEAD` quoted, greps unpiped with exit codes plus a positive control: task-ba1021652dcc4469bc4deb04a8e7d7d5 is DONE on disk AND `git grep -n 'APPROVAL_MISSING_FACT_CODES\[1\]' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.ts` EXIT 0 (the seam now refuses on STEP_UP — EXIT 1 means ba102165 has not advanced the stub or someone landed this: adopt/verify); `git grep -n 'readonly principalId: string' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-ledger-vocabulary.ts` EXIT 0 and the witness still has no transport field; `git grep -n stepUpAuthRef HEAD -- apps ':!*test*' ':!*fixture*'` lists consumers only. Porcelain clean on approval-intent.ts, approval-intent-sources.ts, bootstrap-ledger-vocabulary.ts, daemon-command-registry.ts, daemon-command-edges.ts; live ownership scan.

HumanReviewWitness carries server-known transport facts assembled ONLY at the composition root (daemon-command-registry.ts / daemon-command-edges.ts) from the ingress's own authentication result — the authenticated session id (or the named local-operator case) and the request identity; a payload, header or fixture cannot present one (the existing 'never decoded from bytes' property is re-asserted by an arm); every existing consumer of the witness (grep the type) compiles unchanged and the registry's minting condition (principal === operator) is untouched.

At approval-intent.ts:194 the seam derives `stepUpAuthRef` as a 64-hex replay digest over (transport fact, request identity, runId) through the existing protocol helper, burns it with observeReplayMarker at expected version 0, and ADVANCES the stub: with the fact present the seam's refusal code moves from APPROVAL_INTENT_STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE to APPROVAL_INTENT_BUDGET_REF_UNAVAILABLE (both asserted with layer DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT); with the fact absent it stays STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE. The derived ref satisfies core's validRef (approval-validation.ts:63) and is exposed through a production reader result (not a test helper) for assertion.

ONE-SHOT: a second approval attempt presenting the SAME authentication (same transport fact + request identity) is refused with an exact stable code AND layer naming the replay, and the store holds exactly one SessionAuthorityReplayObserved for that digest; a fresh request identity is admitted. Divergence: only the burn can refuse the replay — delete the burn and the arm reds while every other arm stays green.

Mutation drills, one degree of freedom, restores proven by SHA256 vs %TEMP% backups: (D1) derive the ref from a payload field -> the never-from-bytes arm reds; (D2) delete the burn -> the replay arm reds; (D3) default the ref when the transport fact is absent -> the absence arm reds; (D4) mint the witness's transport fact for a non-operator principal -> the minting-condition arm reds. A green drill is a finding.

Gates standalone, foreground, unpiped, exit 0 with nonzero counts: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` (quote the `$ tsc` echo); from apps/daemon `pnpm exec vitest run src/planning/approval-intent.test.ts src/identity/session-authority.test.ts src/daemon-command-registry.test.ts` (+ any new module's test) with `Test Files N passed`; `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` path-attributed with foreign red disclosed verbatim. Every production source <= 250 lines (split before 400, `.js` bridges); explicit-pathspec commit; completion comment names the seam family (6646f888, ba102165) and states: 'approval.decide_intent now refuses only on BUDGET_REF; stepUpAuthRef is server-derived and one-shot'.
taskRails: The transport fact is a SERVER fact minted at the composition root from the ingress's authentication result; never from payload bytes, headers, capabilities, or fixtures. The witness's existing minting condition (authenticated principal === configured operator) is not loosened.

One-shot semantics via observeReplayMarker/sessionReplayDigest — compose the SessionAuthority replay ledger; never a second ledger, never an in-memory set; session-authority*.ts are composed, not edited.

Absence refuses with the seam's EXISTING code APPROVAL_INTENT_STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE @ DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT; never default a ref, never mint a new code for the same fact. Advancing the refuse-until-fact-exists stub to BUDGET_REF is the deliverable; minting a record is NOT (BUDGET_REF awaits a governor/operator ruling).
Sequenced after task-ba102165 (it owns approval-intent.ts:194 first); re-measure porcelain and ownership at claim; explicit-pathspec commits; foreign WIP preserved.
Fail closed with exact code+layer; TDD red-first through the production command (approval-intent.test.ts harness); <=250 lines per production source.
